failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. No automatic restart, replay, row filtering, roster/role-graph/prompt/geometry/cap change or silent recovery. At most one root-diagnosed recovery re-registration per cell; a second failure closes that flight and the fix must be proven on a four-row dry run first.

hash_caveat: Every composed and protocol hash in this document is the value of the four config fragments exactly as committed on branch fable/b4-prep: readiness held, the preparation requirement present, prepared_phase_supply pinned. core.config.compose hashes the whole merged four-fragment document, so flipping readiness from held to ready and appending the coordinator's own decision requirement each change the composed hash and therefore the protocol hash. prompt_fit.statement: Every B4 cell renders the same two roles cell B0 renders, with the same speech packet, the same instruction bodies and the same two-contact ceiling. The only added prompt volume is revised knowledge-card text and, on cell B4a's Solver, the slot cards the appended general_quirky candidate brings within the unchanged 16/28 caps. Under the repository's stated word proxy every role of every cell fits the 24,576-token slot, the tightest margin being cell B4a's Solver at 5223 tokens under the per-row worst case and far more under the reachable ceiling. Decision ALLOW. This is a bound, not a measurement on the flight tokenizer: each flight fits every realized request itself through build_native_contact_fit_gate, and the coordinator reads those receipts. The one-token-per-added-byte rail is printed for transparency and fails only for cell B4a's Solver per-row worst case, where it overstates a 4,734-word block as 33,226 tokens.

purpose: Three one-factor ORG cells on the cell B0 review-off base. B4a asks whether a standing general_quirky fallback hypothesis together with the one-directional qa/general contrast raises intent -- especially in the general scenario -- without harming SLU. B4b asks whether the date/time/omission-type slot-contract revision reduces date omission and time representation loss and raises pooled SLU. B4c separates the intent-store revision from the fallback candidate and is worth flying only if B4a admits.
quality_gate: No task-quality read before the complete sealed manifest, the exact ordered 1,080 outputs, the native phase summary and the single successful complete official TRAIN score all exist. The comparators are the sealed cell B0 score artifact (primary) and the sealed anchor score artifact (secondary); neither is ever re-flown or re-scored. The four-row smoke is structural only: contact counts, episode receipt fields, the module's own request channel, fit receipts and seal, with no answer, reference or quality interpretation.
